Venue Highlights

Designed for Opulent Celebrations

Everything you need for a seamless, high-energy event under one roof in Miramar, FL.

Built-In Bar Setup

Sleek backlit cocktail bar counter ready for licensed bartenders or bring-your-own-beverage service with ice wells and cocktail glass displays.

Full Commercial Kitchen

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the maximum guest capacity at PartyTime Miramar?
Our Miramar banquet hall comfortably accommodates up to 100 seated guests with banquet round tables, Chiavari chairs, dance floor space, and head table setups.
Can we bring outside catering and drinks?
Yes! PartyTime is an open-caterer venue. You are welcome to bring your own caterer or food. We provide access to our commercial prep kitchen with stainless steel counters, refrigeration, and warming setups.
How does the 360 photo booth add-on work?
Our 360 spin photo booth rental ($150/hr) includes an illuminated LED platform, high-speed camera, custom branded video overlay, party props, cold sparkler FX, and an on-site attendant for instant guest sharing via SMS or AirDrop.
Is the VIP Party Bus available separately?
Yes! You can reserve our 20-30 passenger VIP Party Bus for venue pick-up/drop-off or standalone transportation across Broward and Miami-Dade counties.
